observations.behavior: Adds an Idempotency-Key header to Stripe OAuth refresh requests, derived from the refresh token, and documents that Stripe rolls the refresh token on every exchange, requiring idempotency to recover from lost responses.

observations.posthog_connection: Stripe OAuth refresh token rotation and recovery; the Idempotency-Key header allows PostHog to replay the request after a transient failure without Stripe treating it as a new refresh, preserving the rolled token.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that after a lost response, the request is replayed with the same Idempotency-Key, while subsequent successful responses use a different key, and the refresh token is updated to the rolled value.
observations.posthog_connection: Tests the recovery behavior of Stripe OAuth refresh; while the implementation is not fully shown, this test could not exist without the Idempotency-Key header and token rotation, suggesting the implementation is present elsewhere.
